variants.prompt: On the sun-drenched deck of a luxurious yacht, the striking beauty dons a revealing ensemble. A sheer, rose-gold bikini leaves little to the imagination, its delicate straps framing her ample cleavage and toned midriff. A matching sarong flows behind her, partially obscuring the curve of her hips and thighs. Strappy sandals and oversized, reflective sunglasses complete the glamorous look. Her honey-blonde hair streams in the ocean breeze as she gazes out at the endless blue horizon with a sultry, unguarded smile. Capture her in a wide shot with the yacht's sleek lines and sparkling water in the background, using harsh, unfiltered sunlight and a shallow depth of field.
